units.source_text: 他看惯了京都近郊的“千里竹林”，对竹林并不稀罕。

en.t: He was used to seeing the "thousand-mile bamboo groves" near Kyoto, so bamboo groves were nothing rare to him.

units.source_text: 但是，这贫瘠的山上的竹林，一般都是稀疏地挺立在山的突角上。

en.t: But on these barren mountains, the bamboo groves usually stood sparsely on the jutting points of the hills.

units.source_text: 如果把这山谷当作峡湾，那么竹林就相当于海角的尖端。

en.t: If one thought of this valley as a fjord, then the bamboo groves would correspond to the tips of capes.

units.source_text: 想到这里，他不免隐约感到微微摇曳的竹叶散发出一股海潮的气味。

en.t: Thinking of it this way, he could not help faintly sensing that the gently swaying bamboo leaves gave off the smell of the sea tide.
